notes: ROS 1 (catkin, package.xml format 1). The provided topic cmd_vel_mux/auto_docking exists only under launch/auto_dock_with_safe_keyop.launch; minimal.launch, compact.launch and standalone.launch remap dock_drive/velocity to mobile_base/commands/velocity instead. The code publishes geometry_msgs/Twist from the message_filters ApproximateTime sync callback (queue 10) only when DockDrive is enabled and canRun(); it sets no publish rate (the ros::Rate(10) update thread in src/nodelet.cpp:73-81 is never started, lines 65-69 commented out), so rate_hz is null. min_rate_hz 5.0 is derived from the mux timeout 0.2 s that this package configures for the auto_docking source; it is a consumer-side inactivity threshold, not a publish rate set by the publisher. Frame of the Twist is null: the message has no header and the code names no frame. QoS fields are null because this is ROS 1. topic:cmd_vel_mux/output is not published or subscribed by this package's code; it is named only as the 'from' of a remap on the cmd_vel_mux nodelet the launch file starts, so its port has no type, frame or definition: the package never declares the type of that topic (its own nodes put geometry_msgs/Twist on the remap target mobile_base/commands/velocity, e.g. scripts/DockDriveControl.py:97, but that is not a declaration of cmd_vel_mux/output). references is limited to packet elements; the code also names other packages' topics (odom, mobile_base/sensors/core, mobile_base/sensors/dock_ir, mobile_base/commands/motor_power, mobile_base/commands/velocity, cmd_vel_mux/safety_controller, cmd_vel_mux/keyboard_teleop) and the action dock_drive_action (kobuki_msgs/AutoDocking).
